# Audit: Game Corner while the Game Corner is open is FormB.Show on a
# visible form, which only brings it to the front: the prize, the number
# and the bet stay (seed 201 draws 8, the number bet on).
Money 5000
party 25 10
> start
> menu Actions > Game Corner
> radio FormB.RadioGroup1 1
> type FormB.SpinEdit1 1000
> radio FormB.RadioGroup2 9
> menu Actions > Game Corner
> seed 201
> click FormB.Button1
rand 10 = 8 (the last of 10000)
dialog information "Congratulations! You won! And your prize is..." -> OK
dialog information "10000¥!" -> OK
> state
state battle wild=0 trainer=0 tournament=0 type=0 own=0 hp=0 enemy=0 level=0 hp=0 levels=2-100
state player badges=0 Money=14000 Wins=0 Losses=0 Fights=0 Catches=0 PokeBalls=3 GreatBalls=0 UltraBalls=0 MasterBalls=0 Potions=0 SuperPotions=0 flags=
state dex 25
state party 1:25/L10/1000
> quit
exit 0
save line 9: "5000" -> "14000"
